# LaunchLayer

> Independent PC, laptop and MacBook repair workshop in Wickford, Essex, with free local collection across South Essex and a No-Fix-No-Fee approach.

LaunchLayer is a small local repair and IT business based at 32 Glebe Road, Wickford (SS11 8EU). Work covers home users and small businesses: diagnostics, screen and battery repairs, liquid damage, virus/malware cleanup, data recovery, custom PC builds, and straightforward business IT setup. There is no online checkout — contact or phone to book.

Phone: 07367 652987
Email: hello@launchlayer.uk
Website: https://launchlayer.uk/
